title: inox.toml
description: An Inox mod for Horizon: blocks, items, ores, armour, tools, tags and creative tabs. Reference: docs/inox-mods.md in the Horizon fork.

name.description: A name: [a-z0-9_], 1 to 64 characters. Its id is <mod id>:<name>.

ref.description: A block or item: a name of this mod's (ruby_ingot) or an id (minecraft:stick).

refOrTag.description: A name of this mod's, an id, or a #tag (#c:ingots).

tabId.description: A creative tab: minecraft:building_blocks, minecraft:natural_blocks, minecraft:functional_blocks, minecraft:redstone_blocks, minecraft:tools_and_utilities, minecraft:combat, minecraft:food_and_drinks, minecraft:ingredients, another mod's tab, or one of yours by name.

creativeTabs.description: Other creative tabs it is also in, at their end. It is always in the mod's own tab.

mod.description: Who the mod is, as Options > Mods lists it.

id.description: [a-z0-9_], 1 to 64 characters: the mod's namespace (<id>:ruby), its row in Options > Mods and its log name.

namespaces.description: Extra namespaces your own assets/ and data/ files use. Not minecraft, c or horizon.

template.description: The vanilla block it behaves as (minecraft:iron_block): shape, states, sounds, tool needs and behaviour are copied.

name.description: English name; the name in title case by default.

texture.description: The texture on every face: ruby means assets/<id>/textures/block/ruby.png (must exist); with a : it is a full texture id (minecraft:block/stone). The block's name by default.

model.description: cube_all: a one-texture cube. none: you ship the blockstate and models (stairs, logs, slabs...).

hardness.description: Seconds-to-mine base: -1 is unbreakable, otherwise 0 or more (stone 1.5, iron block 5).

requires_tool.description: Whether it drops only when mined with the right tool.

sounds.description: The vanilla block whose sounds it plays (minecraft:amethyst_block).

item.description: Whether it has an item (placeable, /give-able, in the creative inventory).

drops.description: What breaking it drops: self, none, or an item id.

tool.description: Adds it to minecraft:mineable/<tool>: that tool mines it fast.

template.description: The vanilla item it behaves as (minecraft:diamond_sword, minecraft:golden_apple). All its data components are copied.

name.description: English name; the name in title case by default.

texture.description: assets/<id>/textures/item/<texture>.png (must exist), or a full texture id with :. The item's name by default.

model.description: generated: flat. handheld: held like a tool. none: you ship the item model and definition.

durability.description: Uses before it breaks: iron sword 250, diamond 1561, netherite 2031.

attack_damage.description: As the tooltip shows it (iron sword 6, diamond 7). Set attack_speed too.

attack_speed.description: Attacks a second as the tooltip shows it (swords 1.6). Set attack_damage too.

repair.description: What repairs it in an anvil: an item or a #tag.

always_eat.description: Edible with a full hunger bar.

components.description: Other data components set ("minecraft:max_damage" = 900) or removed ("!minecraft:repairable" = {}).

ore.description: Ore veins by name: [ore.ruby_ore] generates in the biomes it names (new chunks only).

block.description: The block it puts in stone, granite, diorite and andesite.

deepslate_block.description: The block it puts in deepslate and tuff; without it the vein skips them.

size.description: Blocks in a vein (coal 17, iron 9, diamond 4 to 12).

count.description: Veins tried per chunk (iron's middle band 10, gold 4, diamond 7).

shape.description: triangle: most veins in the middle of the range, as iron's and diamond's.

discard_on_air.description: Chance a block touching air is skipped (diamond 0.5).

name.description: The set's name before each piece's: Ruby makes Ruby Helmet.

durability.description: Durability multiplier: leather 5, iron 15, diamond 33, netherite 37.

defense.description: Armour of helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots: iron [2, 6, 5, 2], diamond [3, 8, 6, 3].

name.description: The set's name before each tool's: Ruby makes Ruby Pickaxe.

tier.description: What they mine with drops, and the vanilla tools they copy.

durability.description: wood 59, stone 131, iron 250, gold 32, diamond 1561, netherite 2031.

speed.description: Mining speed: wood 2, stone 4, iron 6, diamond 8, netherite 9, gold 12.

damage.description: Attack bonus: wood and gold 0, stone 1, iron 2, diamond 3, netherite 4.

tag.description: Tags by registry, then name: [tag.item.gems] is <id>:gems; [tag.block."minecraft:beacon_base_blocks"] adds to vanilla's; [tag."worldgen/biome".x] for biomes.

values.description: Names of this mod's things, ids, and #tags.

replace.description: Drop what vanilla and the mods before put in it.

tab.description: Creative tabs of the mod's own: [tab.ruby] is <id>:ruby, on the pages after vanilla's. Without any, the mod gets one tab holding all its items.

name.description: Its title; the mod's name by default.

icon.description: The item on its button; its first item by default.

items.description: What it holds, in order; every item of the mod by default.
